name: MOHAMMED SHAHID
headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Python, Go, Distributed Systems, AI/LLM Integrations
summary: Senior Backend Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems in Python and Go. Delivered and maintained 17+ production applications across MLM, e-commerce, CRM, LMS, ticketing, and customer support domains, including multi-module platforms serving 10,000+ users. Experienced with microservices and monolithic architectures, REST and gRPC APIs, asynchronous and event-driven processing, and PostgreSQL performance tuning, including reducing a critical query from nearly 2 minutes to 5 milliseconds. Integrates LLM capabilities into backend products using the OpenAI, Gemini, and Claude APIs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

bullets: Designed, built, and maintained scalable backend systems and distributed services in Python and Go using Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, Gin, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker.
Delivered and maintained 17+ production applications across MLM, e-commerce, CRM, LMS, ticketing, and customer support domains, serving more than 10,000 users.
Reduced a critical database query's execution time from nearly 2 minutes to 5 milliseconds through query optimization and indexing strategies.
Developed and maintained 50+ REST APIs and built 8 microservices in Python and Go to support asynchronous and event-driven workflows.
Built background workers, cron jobs, WebSocket services, and gRPC-based services for high-performance processing.

Customized and enhanced an 18-module platform spanning user management, binary/unilevel/matrix networks, wallets, commission and ranking engines, subscriptions, payment processing, reporting, notifications, and transaction workflows.
Migrated 10,000+ users and their transactional data across production environments.

Integrated payment, messaging, automation, and AI services, including Stripe, PayPal, NMI, Razorpay, Coinbase, CoinPayments, WhatsApp, Zapier, Mighty Networks, Zoho Desk, AWS SNS, and the OpenAI, Gemini, and Claude APIs.
Independently owned and delivered the ticketing, notification, and customer support modules.

Managed production infrastructure on AWS EC2 with Docker, Nginx, PgBouncer, Redis, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, Sentry, and CI/CD pipelines; handled production incidents, hotfixes, monitoring, and reliability improvements.
Contributed to requirements analysis, system design, database schema design, and architecture discussions, and collaborated directly with clients and cross-functional teams on production releases.
Performed code reviews and mentored 3 junior engineers within a team of 15 developers.
